reason: On this fixed calibration action/estimator family, zero-observation SOR and CC individually cover every layout solved by any of the eight actual methods. No measured quality/cost headroom for routing additional observation. Do not spend sealed-test budget to fit a new rule. This does not establish universal inferiority of active perception or impossibility of an unimplemented policy.
limitations: 4 calibration identities, 16 layouts; exploratory and selected on calibration, no independent generalization test
5 initial geometry rejects retained in denominator; 11 actual eight-arm sets =88 runs, not128 independent runs
No formal C/Q, matched-random B, sealed G2 test, G3 recovery, teacher learning or RSI was executed
Yaw varies between calibration layouts, not a complete within-observation causal action-interaction test
Standard-filter quality tie is observed coverage, not statistical equivalence or noninferiority
Wall time includes CPU simulation and shared-machine scheduling; not model/API inference latency

audit.scope: G2 calibration only. All actual substep contact/hold/path recount; no sealed test or training.
